# Boilerworks Developer Docs

> Documentation for the Boilerworks CLI and template catalogue — 27 production-ready full-stack templates across 10 languages. Install with `pip install boilerworks`, run `boilerworks init`, and ship an app with auth, database, background jobs, Docker, and CI pre-wired.

## Documentation sections

- Home / install: https://boilerworks.dev/
- Getting started: https://boilerworks.dev/getting-started/
- Guides: https://boilerworks.dev/guide/
- CLI reference: https://boilerworks.dev/cli/
- Contributing: https://boilerworks.dev/contributing/

## Related

- Template catalogue and product site: https://boilerworks.ai/ (llms: https://boilerworks.ai/llms.txt)
- Source and all template repos: https://github.com/ConflictHQ
- Built by CONFLICT, an AI-native software engineering firm: https://weareconflict.com/ (full text: https://weareconflict.com/llms-full.txt)
